facts: Parties: Netherby Media Ltd (Buyer), Calloway Retail Group plc (Seller); the Company is Northgate Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 14 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 6 June 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 14 April 2027), either party may terminate.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Saltash Analytics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 12 August 2027.
